By Team Reports 
Nov 19, 2026, 8:00am 
 Crown Point and Penn squared off in some playoff action on Friday, but Crown Point had to settle for second. The matchup between the Bulldogs and the Kingsmen didn't end well, with the Bulldogs falling 44-27. The loss was the Bulldogs' first of the season. They have now allowed more points in their last three games than they did in their previous six.
 Penn's success was the result of a balanced attack that saw several players step up, but Landon Hall led the charge by throwing for 327 yards and 5 touchdowns (1 INT) while completing 76.9% of his passes. The game marked Hall's 10th in a row with at least two passing touchdowns. The team also got some help from Mason Biernacki , who picked up 173 receiving yards and a pair of TDs.
 Crown Point does not have any more games scheduled as of now. As for Penn, they will face off against Carmel at 7:00 p.m. on Friday.
